entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Bondoukou is a diocese located in the city of Bondoukou in the ecclesiastical province of Bouaké in Côte d'Ivoire. It was established on July 3, 1987. Its cathedral is the Cathédrale Saints Odile in Bondoukou. The first two Bishops of Bondoukou were Alexandre Kouassi and Félix Kouadjo. The current bishop was appointed on June 28, 2019.
